ui.usage-tools.add-models-missing-from-t: Add models missing from the built-in table, or override built-in prices. A blank cache price falls back to the input price; 0 is a valid price (free models). Names also match variants with date / latest suffixes.
ui.usage-tools.alerts-are-held-back-duri: Alerts are held back during quiet mode and sent once it ends; usage from unpriced models is not counted. Amounts use the current currency and are converted by the exchange rate when you switch.

ui.usage-tools.automatic-setup-is-not-av: Automatic setup is not available on Windows yet. You can make your Claude Code statusLine script write the rate_limits from stdin to a local file.

ui.usage-tools.claude-code-s-5-hour-week: Claude Code's 5-hour / weekly quota is not written to its session logs; it only appears in the data Claude Code gives to the status line (official docs; Pro / Max plans). You can opt in: Nomi hooks a small local script into ~/.claude/settings.json that saves that data to a file on this computer. Your previous status line command keeps running, and you can turn it off and restore it any time. No credentials are read and nothing goes online.

ui.usage-tools.models-data-sync-note: Goes online on startup (when last checked over 12 hours ago; you can turn this off on the Models page) or when you click. Downloads public model parameters and prices from models.dev (only each model maker's own official prices). No usage or account information is uploaded. If a sync fails, existing prices keep being used. Priority: custom prices > synced prices > built-in prices.

Only trust folders whose contents you know.
ui.usage-tools.only-the-time-model-token: Only the time, model, token counts and session id are extracted; no conversation content is saved and no account credentials are read. With this off, Nomi chat usage is still recorded.
ui.usage-tools.only-tools-signed-in-with: Only tools signed in with an account / subscription have a quota; tools using an API key, a third-party provider or a local route (including Nomi chat) are billed by usage, so only usage and cost are tracked. Quota comes only from data already on this computer and from what the official CLI fetches itself when you click Refresh; the login method is read only from the official login status.

ui.usage-tools.privacy-nomi-never-reads-: Privacy: Nomi never reads, stores or uploads any login credentials (it does not open auth.json, .credentials.json or the system keychain). When you click Refresh and the snapshot is out of date, the official CLI (claude -p /usage, codex app-server, Grok ACP billing) is started briefly and fetches the quota with its own login; Nomi keeps only the percentage, window, reset time and plan. Note that Codex sends one request to OpenAI for this. There is no automatic polling, and each tool is refreshed at most once per 60 seconds; you can turn off "Active quota refresh" under "Privacy & data".
